topic.source_contract: UKHSA-BGS radon potential, affected-area and building-protection evidence

facts.status: current definitive Radon Affected Areas map
facts.guard: radon potential is not an indoor measurement
atlas class is an area probability and not a building result

facts.map: authoritative likelihood of a building being in an affected area
facts.guard: affected-area status does not prove concentration
general advice is not a candidate test result
property potential does not replace long-duration testing

scope_guards: Radon potential is the estimated likelihood of elevated levels and is not a measured indoor concentration.
Affected-area mapping and property-level potential outputs remain distinct from a building test.
The 200 Bq/m³ action level applies to measured annual-average concentration, not map class alone.
New-building protective-measure guidance does not prove measures were designed, installed or certified.
Every building can contain radon; a lower-potential area is not zero-radon evidence.
Map cells and affected-area classes are not HMLR title or exact building footprints.
Radon evidence is not planning permission, structural condition or health diagnosis.
No score or promotion is written without exact property potential, valid measurement, building design and current planning evidence.
